title: LACE-DR: Local Adaptive Contrastive Encoding with Distributionally-Robust Reconstruction for Anomaly Detection in Attributed Networks
description: Implementation of LACE-DR, an unsupervised node-anomaly detector for attributed graphs, and the scripts that reproduce the LACE-DR results reported in the accompanying paper (anomaly injection, training, evaluation, robustness and ablation studies).
